Redact a PDF and remove the text for good

Drag over what you need to hide and download. Each redacted page is rebuilt from pixels, so the hidden text cannot be copied, searched or recovered from the new file. Your document is processed in this browser tab and never uploaded.

How to redact a PDF

  1. Select Open PDF and choose the document.
  2. Select Redact and drag over each area you want to remove.
  3. Check every page, then select Download.

How your files are handled

Your files are opened, changed and saved by this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file on your device is never modified. Closing the tab discards everything, so download your result first.

Questions

Is the text really removed, or just covered?
Removed. A redacted page is rebuilt from pixels with the black boxes already in place, so the original text, images and annotation text on that page are not copied into the download. This is tested by redacting a marker word and searching the downloaded file’s text, annotations, metadata, bookmarks and raw data for it.
What happens to the rest of a redacted page?
It stays visible but becomes an image, so its text can no longer be selected or searched. Pages without redactions keep their text.
Is the document’s metadata removed?
The download is a new file. It does not copy the original title, subject, keywords or bookmarks.
Can it find and redact a word everywhere?
No. You mark each area yourself, so check every page before you download.
Are my files uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser with PDF.js and pdf-lib. Your documents are never sent to a server.
What are the limits?
Up to 50 MB per PDF, 100 MB in total and 200 pages. Password-protected PDFs are not supported.
